claim: Patchline ships a verified constraint solver core proving every reported conflict is a real unsatisfiable constraint. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the verified constraint solver claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make verified-constraint-solver-gate`.
